name: ExaBricks Hierarchy
definition: A data structure that re-organizes input AMR cells into a set of compact, non-overlapping bricks containing only same-level cells, designed to support high-quality cell interpolation across level boundaries and efficient ray tracing.
summary: ExaBricks Hierarchy reorganizes AMR data into compact bricks for smooth interpolation and efficient hardware-accelerated ray tracing, avoiding costly k-d tree traversals.
